# foshanFFE.com

> Foshan-based hospitality FF&E integrator coordinating 19+ specialized factories for hotel projects worldwide. One PO covers full guestroom + public area FF&E — from design to container.

## About

foshanFFE.com is the online presence of a professional hotel FF&E (Furniture, Fixtures & Equipment) integrator headquartered in Foshan, Guangdong, China — the world's largest furniture manufacturing cluster. Unlike traditional furniture factories that produce only their own product lines, foshanFFE.com operates as an **integrator**, unifying 19+ certified partner factories under one contract, one QC standard, and one purchase order.

**Core value proposition:** One PO. Full FF&E. Zero Hassle.

**Target markets:** Middle East (Saudi Arabia, UAE, Qatar), North America (USA, Canada), Australia, Europe, Southeast Asia.

**Hotel segments served:** 5-star luxury hotels, boutique hotels, resorts, serviced apartments, motel renovations, cruise ships.

## Key Capabilities

- **Full-package hotel FF&E:** Guestroom furniture, lobby furniture, restaurant & bar furniture, outdoor/terrace furniture, suite furniture, custom millwork
- **Product categories:** Casegoods, soft seating, beds, desks, wardrobes, nightstands, dining tables, chairs, banquet furniture, lighting, mattresses, drapery, bath vanities, wall panels, doors, hardware, tiles, aluminum veneer, smart locks, sanitary ware
- **Hard finishes integration:** Stone (granite/quartz), glass, aluminum panels, metal ceilings, wrought iron — coordinated through the 19-factory partner network
- **Certifications:** UL, CARB P2, FSC, BS 7177, CAL 117, AS/NZS 3744, ISO, EN 16798, CE
- **Services:** Design optimization, shop drawing, mock-up room, DUPRO inspection, pre-shipment QC, consolidated container loading, logistics & shipping, on-site installation guidance

## Differentiators

1. **Integrator model, not factory:** 19 specialized factories coordinated under one management — widest category coverage without diluting quality
2. **One PO full-package:** Single contract covers guestroom, lobby, restaurant, outdoor, lighting, mattress, drapery, bath vanities, and hard finishes
3. **Unified QC standard:** Cross-category finish consistency guaranteed — same veneer grade, color tone, and fire rating across all items
4. **Consolidated logistics:** All items loaded into shared containers from one warehouse, reducing shipping costs and damage risk
5. **Single accountability:** One project manager, one warranty, one point of contact for the entire project
